sam: Quick follow-up from PM-2910: we need concrete owners + tickets for the incident-driven test work. Recommend: prompt set, load drill, and fallback harness.

ana: I can build the prompt set. plan: 120 prompts, split 'latency-only' vs 'semantic', include CSV with validator hints. Target 5 days.

mira: Good. todd can you own the load drill? we need reproducible scripts and a stage job.

todd: I'll take it. prototype scripts in infra/tests/load, stage-only run: 15m ramp 50->800 qps, restart 30% cache pods mid-run. Ticket INF-4321.

ana: i'll pull samples from s3://redwood-prod/incident-dumps and tag sources in the ticket.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4320 by ana - "incident prompt set: 120 samples"

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4321 by todd - "stage load drill + KV eviction"

mira: sam, can you own the fallback harness + CI glue? need a small runner that toggles routing variants and asserts error-rate < 0.5%.

sam: on it. will add `ci/evals/incident-resilience` and mock routing table. ticket INF-4322. ETA 10 days.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4322 by sam - "fallback resilience harness + CI"

todd: I'll include a suggested wrk command in the ticket and monitoring hooks for p95 and kv-miss.

ana: note on validators: latency-only prompts use prefix/regex and length ranges, semantic ones get stricter checks.

mira: please link each INF ticket back to PM-2910 and add repro steps + small artifacts. we'll review in the ops sync in 2 weeks.

sam: linking now.

ops-bot: Linked INF-4320 -> PM-2910; INF-4321 -> PM-2910; INF-4322 -> PM-2910

ana: PR for prompt CSV coming shortly.

todd: scheduling draft drill next week, will post runbook snippet.

mira: thanks all. we'll close the loop at the sync and add a monthly mini-drill to keep these tests exercised. :+1:
